verdict.rationale: Kino is a video-editing product whose clips stream from its cloud and are transcribed and described, so data retention and deletion is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents retention periods, deletion of footage, transcripts or derived data, or any user-facing privacy controls. The mentions of "no account needed" and cloud streaming do not show that a user can control retention or deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
